posts.title: We swapped 20 guessed constants in DTE for one engine
posts.description: vx DTE's planner was a pile of greedy rules that fought each other. One engine with one objective replaced them. Full runs of vx's own CI went from about 40 s past their ideal to 9 to 19 s.

posts.title: Turborepo, Nx and Vite Task undo your commit on a cache hit
posts.description: Commit a file that sits in a task’s output folder. On the next cache hit, Turborepo, Nx and Vite Task write the old copy back over it, and the run reports success.

posts.title: A sandboxed task reads what it depends on, and nothing beside it
posts.description: A sandboxed task can read the outputs of the tasks it depends on, in any project, and never their sources. With hermetic: true it reads nothing of the machine you did not name.
